content.text: The student rearranges the circuit so that the two resistors are connected in series and the voltmeter is connected to measure the potential difference across both resistors. content.html: Theory suggests that RS = 4RP if the two resistors have the same value. State whether your results indicate that the resistors have the same value. Justify your answer with reference to the results.
